messages:
maria_ml: Quick heads-up — after PTQing the new cross-encoder reranker we saw a ~1.8pt drop in NDCG@10 on webqa-2025. Anyone else?

samir_infra: saw a similar dip on internal-fusion too, but only for queries where the doc context > 2k tokens.

li_engineer: can you paste the eval command you ran?

maria_ml: sure — ran the standard eval harness: 
```
./eval_rerank --model=rerank-xl-base-ptq --dataset=webqa-2025 --metric=ndcg@10,mrr@10 --bootstrap=10000 --seed=42
```

natalie_research: interesting — when we PTQed earlier, the biggest regressions were correlated with formatting differences (title vs body concatenation). Did you use the same doc formatting as baseline?

maria_ml: we used doc_format: "title + SEP + body_trunc(1600)" which matches the baseline. but I did try a variant with full body and sliding windows for long docs and that actually reduced the delta.

ben_ops: worth checking tokenization edgecases — PTQ can amplify small token-boundary shifts. Did you normalize whitespace/HTML?

maria_ml: we strip HTML and collapse whitespace but keep original punctuation. I can run a quick ablation: keep title-only vs title+body vs BM25-top-k snippets.

natalie_research: also check ndcg@5 vs ndcg@10. In our experiments PTQ hurt deeper ranks more (NDCG@10) but ndcg@1 was basically flat. That suggests top result scoring preserved but tail reordering got noisy.

li_engineer: reproducible snippet for bootstrap significance: 
```
# eval script
./eval_rerank \ 
  --model=rerank-xl-base-ptq \ 
  --dataset=webqa-2025 \ 
  --metric=ndcg@10 --bootstrap=10000 --alpha=0.01 --save-deltas=out/deltas.json
```

samir_infra: I'd also compare against INT8 QAT run we have in staging (rerank-xl-qat). PTQ might be missing small-scale calibration for attention scaling.

maria_ml: good call — I'll run PTQ vs QAT vs FP32 on subset (long-doc & short-doc) splits. Any recommended split sizes?

natalie_research: 5k queries each split is enough for stable bootstrap CI. Make a split by doc_token_length quartiles and by query length. Also track MRR and pairwise inversion rate.

ben_ops: FYI the dedicated pool that runs QAT jobs is free to use this afternoon — ping me if you need infra.

maria_ml: thanks. one more thing: should we change chunk order when constructing BM25 candidates? right now we sort chunks by BM25 score but concatenation order can affect cross-encoder scoring.

natalie_research: yes — try two experiments: (A) top-k chunks concatenated by BM25 rank, (B) top single chunk only, (C) title + top-3 chunks concatenated. Record ndcg@1/5/10. We saw (C) often recovers PTQ regressions because the title provides a strong anchor.

ci-bot: CI: rerank-eval-1917001234 finished — 4 tasks, 0 failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/1917001234

eval-bot: Eval summary (quick): rerank-xl-base-ptq vs fp32 on webqa-2025 (pilot 1k): NDCG@10 -1.6 (bootstrap p=0.007), MRR -0.9 (p=0.02). Full runs pending.

maria_ml: great — I'll run full split experiments and post results. tagging @natalie @samir for visibility. :eyes:
